purpose: Mate the exact EastRising ER-TFT035IPS-6 plus ER-TPC035-6 configured assembly directly to the UI PCB through one serviceable 50-contact ZIF; the enclosure bezel and compliant panel bed carry every mechanical load.

components.role: direct dual-contact 50-position ZIF for the exact 0.30-mm EastRising tail

mechanical_retention.panel_support: continuous front-shell display bed plus bezel overlap outside the active and touch areas
mechanical_retention.primary_retention: thin perimeter display-grade PSA on the front-shell bed
mechanical_retention.secondary_retention: four corner locators and a compliant 0.5-1.0-mm closed-cell rear preload pad
mechanical_retention.flex_strain_relief: controlled folded-tail corridor from the antenna edge to the direct ZIF; no tensile or peel load reaches the contacts or latch
mechanical_retention.service_rule: opening the sandwich exposes the ZIF latch; release the latch before lifting the display assembly

physical_realization.part_type: integral enclosure geometry, not a separate purchased part
physical_realization.implementation: the front shell contains one rigid recessed ledge under the panel perimeter and one continuous bezel lip; the visible opening stays outside the exact 49.96 x 74.44-mm viewing area and the lip never bears on the active touch surface
physical_realization.load_role: supports panel depth and transfers normal and finger loads into the front shell

physical_realization.implementation: 0.10-0.20-mm target thickness; applied only around the documented inactive perimeter between the panel assembly and the rigid shell bed; no liquid glue
physical_realization.load_role: retains the panel against lift and distributes load without loading the glass active area
physical_realization.release_gate: freeze exact adhesive grade and cut drawing after the assembler accepts the one-prototype display-installation operation

physical_realization.part_type: four short ribs integral to the front shell
physical_realization.implementation: one rib at each panel corner, outside the touch/viewing area; target lateral assembly clearance is 0.20-0.30 mm per side before final enclosure-tolerance closure
physical_realization.load_role: takes in-plane shear so ordinary handling does not peel the PSA or pull the FPC

physical_realization.part_type: die-cut closed-cell urethane- or silicone-foam pad
physical_realization.implementation: 0.5-1.0-mm nominal thickness with 15-30-percent target compression after shell closure; bonded to the shell support surface and applied only to a documented safe rear-panel zone, never across the FPC or components
physical_realization.load_role: removes rattle and maintains light seating against the front bed
physical_realization.release_gate: freeze exact foam grade, thickness and safe-zone cutout from the received-panel tolerance stack and enclosure drawing

physical_realization.part_type: integral shell corridor with optional low-tack polyimide guide tab
physical_realization.implementation: controls bend radius and preserves service slack between the antenna-edge tail exit and the ZIF
physical_realization.load_role: prevents panel motion from becoming tensile or peel load at the ZIF contacts

mechanical_retention.structural_load_path: finger or handling load -> bezel and rigid display bed -> front shell -> enclosure stops and fasteners; never through the FPC or ZIF

esp32_div_v2_reference.panel_mount: raw 2.8-inch display body seated directly on the main PCB
esp32_div_v2_reference.in_plane_location: four 1.2-mm copper-free locator holes on a 49.10 x 68.25-mm rectangle accept the display-frame locating features
esp32_div_v2_reference.electrical_connection: 18-contact display FPC soldered directly to eighteen 0.4 x 4.5-mm SMD lands; no display ZIF
esp32_div_v2_reference.not_publicly_documented: no controlled adhesive, foam-preload or display-screw specification is present in the published v2 PCB and 3D-model sources
esp32_div_v2_reference.leshy2_adoption_rule: copy exact enclosure-bed and anti-shear location, not the load-bearing direct-soldered flex; Leshy2 keeps a serviceable non-load-bearing ZIF

electrical.signal_contract: the UI PCB routes every required panel power, ground, i8080-8, recovery and touch net directly to the exact 50-contact connector; manufacturer NC and SDO contacts remain open
electrical.recovery_mode: deliberate strap change to ILI9488 4-wire serial; no QSPI claim

recovery_straps.primary_population: i8080-8: pin 34 and TE pin 39 are open; pin 38 CS is strapped low; RD is strapped high; IM2/IM1/IM0 = 0/1/1
recovery_straps.serial_recovery: service-only solder-jumper population links panel SDA pin 34 to S3 LCD_DB7/GPIO46 and moves CS pin 38 from ground to S3 LCD_DB6/GPIO42; the mode-select jumpers are repopulated to the manufacturer 4-wire-serial code
recovery_straps.safety: all recovery pads are on the opened inner face and cannot change mode during normal use

electrical.h2_rule: H2 places this connector on the UI PCB and routes the accepted panel map directly; no display adapter PCB or board-to-board display connector is populated.

orientation.panel_rule: mount the configured panel with its folded FPC toward the antenna edge, as on ESP32-DIV, so the tail never enters the LED, navigation or function-key zone
orientation.display_memory_transform: rotate ILI9488 output by 180 degrees relative to its cable-down native orientation
orientation.touch_transform: rotate FT6236 coordinates by 180 degrees before UI hit-testing
orientation.tail_contract: manufacturer drawing controls the 50-contact 0.50-mm-pitch, 0.30-mm-stiffened folded tail; H5 incoming inspection verifies lot conformity and insertion

evidence.finding: EastRising controls the 50-contact 0.50-mm tail, complete CTP outline, 8080-8 strap and every LCD/touch/backlight contact.
Exact ER-TFT035IPS-6 is orderable at quantity one with the ER-TPC035-6 capacitive-touch option.
FH34SRJ-50S-0.5SH(50) is exact HRS original-manufacturer C3169104, Extended SMT, Economic/Standard PCBA, MOQ 1 and verified live stock.

The official ESP32-DIV v2 PCB uses four display locator holes and eighteen direct-solder FPC lands rather than a display ZIF; its public sources do not specify a controlled adhesive or foam-preload stack.

release_boundary: H1 freezes the exact panel, direct C3169104 ZIF position, 50-contact electrical map, folded-tail corridor and non-load-bearing connector rule. H2 imports the exact footprint and routes the display sheet directly on the UI PCB; H5 confirms current-lot tail conformity, written factory acceptance for panel PSA/FPC insertion and one-prototype final mating.
